title: Podcast RSS feed generation
description: Generate standard podcast RSS/Atom feeds from podcast_series+episodes. Compatible with Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and podcast apps. Includes enclosure tags, iTunes categories, chapter markers. Each podcast series is also an AP Actor for federation.
close_reason: Funkwhale audio mode complete. audio_db (25 functions, 28 tests), podcast_rss (XML generator, 10 tests), funkwhale_api (types+routes, 15 tests).
